QUOTE: **`not_indexed` / `not_indexed_count`:** file types the build walked and produced no rows for. The build measured this against its own tree, not the query-time tree.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the reply carries `not_indexed`, the file types that were in scope (walked) but produced no rows. It also separates "not indexed" from "absent from the tree".
